notes_for_editor: Height conflict is unresolved: the compilation's entry gives 100 feet, and the 1959 survey note gives an overall height of 115 feet, so height_m is left out. The 1972 removal date and the Highway 38 location both come from the 2025 compilation alone; the handbook gives only the distance north of Marcell and is undated in the copy read. No builder, build year or staffing is in any source read. A web search snippet mentioned an 80-foot tower near Marcell dismantled in 1946; the compilation does not link it to Stokes, it was not verified on any page read, and it is left out. The record's county (Itasca) and coordinates match the Fire Lookout Association and the compilation.
